metas.name: 1. A Princess, an Elf, and a Demon Walk Into a Bar
metas.description: Princess Bean already has the wedding day blues when a mysterious figure arrives, claiming he's her personal demon. Elfo hates his happy homeland.

metas.name: 2. For Whom the Pig Oinks
metas.description: How to get rid of an unwanted fiancé? Bean's plan involves a party barge and mermaids. King Zøg tries to make Elfo's blood into an immortality potion.

metas.name: 3. The Princess of Darkness
metas.description: Sorcerio declares that demonic possession is behind Bean's drunken exploits -- and things look dicey for Luci when the king hires an eerie exorcist.

metas.name: 4. Castle Party Massacre
metas.description: With the king away, Bean throws a wild party while Odval and Sorcerio gather their secret society for a ritual. But the night takes a surprising turn.

metas.name: 5. Faster, Princess! Kill! Kill!
metas.description: Banished from the castle by Zøg, Bean tries to work but has trouble keeping a job. Elfo encounters a bizarre pair of siblings living in a candy house.

metas.name: 6. Swamp and Circumstance
metas.description: Bean tries her hand at diplomacy after Zøg makes her ambassador to Dankmire, Oona's kingdom and an important ally for Dreamland.

metas.name: 7. Love's Tender Rampage
metas.description: Elfo lies to hide his feelings for Bean, but things get complicated when she tries to help him by sending the knights on a quest.

metas.name: 8. The Limits of Immortality
metas.description: Elfo's been kidnapped! Bean, Luci, Sorcerio and the knights search for him, along with a magical pendant needed to complete the immortality potion.

metas.name: 9. To Thine Own Elf Be True
metas.description: After he learns a surprising secret about himself, Elfo heads home to Elfwood in search of the truth.

metas.name: 10. Dreamland Falls
metas.description: As Dreamland celebrates an unexpected arrival while saying goodbye to a friend, everyday life is thrown into disarray.

metas.name: 11. The Disenchantress
metas.description: Bean travels with Dagmar to her homeland, Maru, where she rescues an old friend and learns of a mysterious prophecy she's expected to fulfill.

metas.name: 12. Stairway to Hell
metas.description: Bean and Luci concoct a plan to resurrect Elfo. But he'll have to meet them in hell -- if he can get there. Zøg discovers a friend in frozen Dreamland.

metas.name: 13. The Very Thing
metas.description: Bean and her friends return to Dreamland but don't receive a warm welcome from Zøg. Oona inspires a lackluster band of pirates who rescue her at sea.

metas.name: 14. The Lonely Heart Is a Hunter
metas.description: Bean dreams about her mother and finds mystical Maruvian symbols around the castle. Zøg falls for an unusual woman he meets in the Enchanted Forest.

metas.name: 15. Our Bodies, Our Elves
metas.description: With a health crisis in Elf Alley, Bean and Elfo make a dangerous journey to find an ancient cure while Luci scams sick elves at his new clinic.

metas.name: 16. The Dreamland Job
metas.description: Learning that the elves are starving because of Zøg's excessive taxes, Bean plans a heist with a passing band of circus performers to recover the money.

metas.name: 17. Love's Slimy Embrace
metas.description: Despondent because Bean dislikes him and his mother's away, Derek makes friends with a slimy sea creature. Zøg tries to contract a rich man's disease.

metas.name: 18. In Her Own Write
metas.description: While Zøg refuses to face his feelings about Dagmar's betrayal, Bean writes to deal with her pain. But she faces obstacles to sharing her work.

metas.name: 19. The Electric Princess
metas.description: When a scientific man appears in Dreamland, he's regarded with suspicion. But Bean helps him escape and travels with him to a wondrous steampunk city.

metas.name: 20. Tiabeanie Falls
metas.description: With King Zøg incapacitated, Odval makes a power play, assisted by the Arch Druidess. Luci and Elfo try to help Bean.
